name: arc-rectangle-denoise
description: Use when an ARC grid has a dominant background, scattered noise pixels, and a partially corrupted solid rectangle. Infer the rectangle, restore its fill, and remove noise.
---

# ARC rectangle denoising

Use this pattern when examples show one or more solid rectangular color regions amid isolated distractor pixels.

1. Identify the background color and the main rectangular regions from repeated color runs and aligned edges.
2. Infer each rectangle's full bounds, including rows or columns whose fill is interrupted by other colors.
3. Fill every cell inside those bounds with the rectangle's color.
4. Treat isolated non-background pixels outside the rectangles as noise and replace them with the background color.
5. Preserve any other coherent rectangles or objects shown by examples; do not assume every non-background color is noise without checking structure.
6. Verify the output dimensions remain unchanged and every inferred rectangle is solid.

In the observed example, the coherent colored block was a 5-column by 6-row rectangle; intruding pixels within it were replaced by its fill color and scattered same-colored pixels outside it were removed.",
